encounters.title: Convoy Under Siege
encounters.description: A League supply convoy burns in the void ahead. Raiders circle like vultures. Through the smoke, a single cruiser holds formation, shields flickering. The comms crackle with a familiar voice: 'This is Commander Charlie of the LSS Stalwart. Any friendly vessels — we are taking heavy fire.'

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: This is Commander Charlie of the LSS Stalwart! Shields at twelve percent — any friendly vessel, we are taking heavy fire!

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: Charlie? Charlie! It's Dave. Hold your position — we're coming in.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: Dave?! You magnificent mutt! I haven't heard that voice since graduation night. You still owe me for the mess hall incident, by the way.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: We can settle debts later. Right now you've got six raiders on your tail and a convoy to save. What's the play?

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: I've been holding formation for twenty minutes with duct tape and stubbornness. These raiders hit hard but they're disorganised. If you can break their line, I can cover the transports.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: I see two options. We go in loud and scatter them head-on, or I loop around and we catch them in a pincer.

choices.text: Full speed — break the ambush and protect the convoy.

outcome.description: You dive into the fray. Together, your ship and Charlie's cruiser scatter the raiders. When the smoke clears, Charlie's battered face appears on screen, grinning ear to ear.

choices.text: Circle around — hit the raiders from behind while Charlie holds the line.

outcome.description: The flanking manoeuvre is textbook. Caught between two fires, the raiders break and scatter.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: Ha HA! Just like the academy drills! You always did love the direct approach, Dave.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: And you always did love complaining about it while it worked.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: Fair point. Convoy's safe, raiders are running, and I owe you a drink. Actually, I owe you several. Get over here so I can shake your paw, Captain.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: Classic pincer — straight out of Commander Hawke's playbook! I always said you paid more attention in tactics class than you let on.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: I just let you believe you were the smart one. Kept you motivated.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: Unbelievable. Five years and you're still winding me up. Get over here, Dave — I want to see the ship that just saved my tail.

encounters.title: Charlie Joins the Crew
encounters.description: Charlie surveys the damage to his cruiser and shakes his head. 'The Stalwart's done. Reactor's cracked.' He turns to Dave, suddenly serious. 'My convoy crew is safe — I've radioed for League pickup. But I'm not waiting around for a desk assignment.'

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: She's done, Dave. Reactor's cracked clean through. The Stalwart held together long enough to save the convoy, and that's all I can ask.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: I'm sorry, Charlie. I know what that ship meant to you.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: Ships can be replaced. People can't. My convoy crew is safe — League pickup is en route.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: But I'll be honest with you, Dave. Command is going to ground me. Stick me behind a desk reviewing supply manifests. I'd rather eat my own tail.

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: You know what I'm doing out here isn't exactly sanctioned.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: I know. The crystal mission. The whole fleet's been whispering about it.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: You need someone who knows League formations inside-out, who can hold a line when things go sideways, and who won't flinch when the orders stop making sense. That's me, Dave. It's always been me.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: Permission to come aboard, Captain?

choices.text: Permission granted. Welcome aboard, First Mate.

outcome.description: Charlie snaps a salute — then breaks into a grin and pulls Dave into a rough hug. He takes the First Mate's station like he was born to it.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: First Mate Charlie, reporting for duty!

dialogue_steps.speaker: dave
dialogue_steps.text: Try not to break this ship too.

dialogue_steps.speaker: charlie
dialogue_steps.text: No promises. But I'll keep her flying, Dave. You point us at trouble, and I'll make sure we come out the other side. Just like the academy — except this time, the stakes are real.
